defs.def: a meal eaten in the middle of the day 午餐；午饭verb

ex.s: Customers can also place pickup orders online for lunch or dinner until 8:00 pm six days a week.
ex.t: 顾客也可以在线下单自取午餐或晚餐，每周六天营业至晚上8点。

ex.s: Bring a personal water bottle, sunscreen, and lunch.
ex.t: 带上自己的水壶、防晒霜和午餐。

ex.s: If I asked what she had for lunch, she might say, “Oh, the weather has been lovely today. ” She seemed to recycle the same handful of answers to my questions.
ex.t: 如果我问她午饭吃了什么，她可能会说："哦，今天天气真好。"她似乎总在用同样那几个答案应付我的问题。

ex.s: Back downtown during a workday, they can enjoy a more domestic form of this interaction by walking along a fountain on their lunch break.
ex.t: 回到市中心的上班日，他们可以在午休时间沿着喷泉散步，享受这种互动的一种更居家化的形式。

ex.s: Campers have a three-hour morning class engaging with a morning theme (9am to 12 noon) and a one-hour lunch break, followed by another three-hour class engaging with an afternoon theme (1pm to 4pm).
ex.t: 营员有一个三小时的上午课程（围绕上午主题，早9点至中午12点）和一个一小时的午休，之后是另一个三小时的下午课程（围绕下午主题，下午1点至4点）。

ex.s: All campers should bring their own bagged lunch and snacks.
ex.t: 所有营员应自带午餐和零食。

ex.s: After our third run Andrew shut down the engine, and we went our separate ways — he for a lunch break, I to explore the city.
ex.t: 第三趟航行结束后Andrew关掉发动机，我们各奔东西——他去吃午饭，我去探索这座城市。

ex.s: Pasta and pizza were on everyone’s lunch menu in my native land of Italy.
ex.t: 在我的祖国意大利，意大利面和披萨是每个人午餐菜单上的食物。

ex.s: Everyone who had such a lunch was fair-skinned and spoke Italian.
ex.t: 每个吃这样午餐的人都肤色白皙，说意大利语。

ex.s: A few years later, as I stood in the lunch line with my kindergarten class in a school in Brooklyn, I realized things were no longer that simple.
ex.t: 几年后，当我和幼儿园班级站在布鲁克林一所学校的午餐队伍里时，我意识到事情不再那么简单了。

ex.s: New immigrants much like the little girl in the lunch line flooded our office seeking help.
ex.t: 和午餐队伍中的小女孩很像的新移民大量涌入我们的办公室寻求帮助。

ex.s: The young banker who eats lunch at his desk is probably seen as a go-getter, while his colleagues who chat over a relaxed conference-room meal get dirty looks from the corner office.
ex.t: 那个在办公桌前吃午餐的年轻银行家可能被视为有上进心的人，而他在会议室轻松用餐的同事则会从角落办公室投来厌恶的目光。

ex.s: Lunch is Bechtel’s “me” time.
ex.t: 午餐时间是贝克特尔的"自我"时间。

ex.s: More than half（53 percent）have breakfast alone and nearly half（46 percent）have lunch by themselves.
ex.t: 超过一半（53%）的人独自吃早餐，近半数（46%）的人独自吃午餐。

ex.s: Bechtel，who works in downtown West Palm Beach，has lunch with coworkers sometimes，but like many of us，too often works through lunch at her desk.
ex.t: 贝克特尔在西棕榈滩市中心工作，有时会和同事一起吃午餐，但像我们许多人一样，她也经常在办公桌前边工作边吃午餐。

ex.s: just two seats over，Andrew Mazoleny，a local videographer，is finishing his lunch at the bar.
ex.t: 只隔两个座位，当地摄像师安德鲁·马佐莱尼正在吧台吃完他的午餐。

ex.s: Why does Bechtel prefer to go out for lunch?
ex.t: 贝克特尔为什么更喜欢出去吃午餐？

ex.s: Before I knew it an hour had passed and it was time to move on to lunch.
ex.t: 不知不觉中，一个小时过去了，该去吃午饭了。

ex.s: Our café offers a complete menu of lunch and snack options, in addition to seasonal specials.
ex.t: 我们的咖啡馆提供完整的午餐和小吃菜单，此外还有季节特色菜。

ex.s: And it was accompanied in the nest by the greatest sight of all — LUNCH!
ex.t: 巢里还伴随着最棒的景象——午餐！

ex.s: The attacker who was lunching now becomes lunch.
ex.t: 原本正在享用美餐的攻击者现在变成了别人的美餐。

ex.s: Some plants pump out smelly chemicals to keep insects away.But others do double duty .They pump out perfumes designed to attract different insects who are natural enemies to the attackers.Once they arrive,the tables are turned .The attacker who was lunching now becomes lunch.
ex.t: 一些植物释放出难闻的化学物质来驱赶昆虫。但另一些植物则一石二鸟。它们释放出特意设计的香气，以吸引不同种类的昆虫，而这些昆虫正是攻击者的天敌。一旦它们到来，局势便发生逆转。原本在进食的攻击者现在变成了食物。

ex.s: Suggestions to the Head Teacher (1 picture) ·What to change: lunch break, school uniform, ...
ex.t: 给班主任的建议（ 1张照片） ·更改内容：午餐休息、校服、……

ex.s: In some Western countries, lunch is usually eaten at about 1 pm.
ex.t: 在一些西方国家，午餐通常在下午1点左右吃。

ex.s: To cheer her up, we went to a typical Quebec restaurant for lunch.
ex.t: 为了让她振作起来，我们去了一家典型的魁北克餐厅吃午饭。

ex.s: We were eating lunch on a high rimrock, at the foot of which a turbulent river elbowed its way.
ex.t: 我们正在一块高高的岩壁上吃午餐，其脚下有一条湍急的河流蜿蜒而过。

ex.s: The Diary of a Young Girl WEDNESDAY, 3 MAY 1944 Dearest Kitty, For the last two weeks we’ve been eating lunch at eleven-thirty on Saturdays; in the mornings we have to make do with a cup of cereal.
ex.t: 《一个年轻女孩的日记》：1944年5月3日，星期三。最亲爱的凯蒂，最近两个星期六我们都在十一点半吃午饭；早上我们只能凑合着喝一杯麦片粥。
